# pheno-ci-templates

## Overview

Canonical reusable GitHub Actions CI + release workflows for the **pheno-\***
fleet. One source of truth for four languages (Rust, Python, Go, Node);
each consumer pulls the workflows via `uses:` and only sees the language
jobs that match the manifests present in the caller repo.

## Files

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — reusable CI workflow (fmt, clippy, test, coverage)
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` — reusable release workflow (crates.io, npm, PyPI, Go)

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|---------|
| `rust_msrv` | string | `1.75` | Rust toolchain version |
| `python_version` | string | `3.11` | Python version |
| `go_version` | string | `1.22` | Go version |
| `node_version` | string | `20` | Node.js version |
| `run_coverage` | boolean | `false` | Run coverage reporting |
| `run_clippy` | boolean | `true` | Run `cargo clippy` with `-D warnings` |

## Usage

```yaml
jobs:
  ci:
    uses: KooshaPari/pheno-ci-templates/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main
    with:
      rust_msrv: "1.75"
      run_coverage: true
    secrets: inherit
```
